headline: Waiver allowing 2 1/2 ft of pipe cover under Wilson Road at 23 Wilson Road granted.
summary: Staff recommended the waiver on the condition that the pipe be reinforced concrete, and staff said the applicant has made that change. The culvert would drain a low spot across the road from the site, and the applicant said the town would maintain the detention ponds. The applicant also withdrew its request for 60 residential units at 196 and 198 Rockingham Road.
decisions: Granted a waiver allowing 2 1/2 ft of pipe cover under Wilson Road at 23 Wilson Road, 5-0.
discussion: Culvert pipe cover: Members asked why the pipe could not get 3 ft of cover. The applicant said raising the road would conflict with sight distance rules, and the reinforced concrete pipe is rated to carry fire trucks.

Water at Wilson Road curve: Concerns were raised about a puddle at a driveway end across from the culvert, near a curve. One account described a car sliding into a snowbank there. The applicant said the curve would improve slightly and sight distance would be much better.

Detention pond and tree clearing: A public speaker asked about the pond's size, tree clearing near his property, and whether Wilson Road stays one-way. The chair asked staff to connect the speaker with engineering for answers.

Nitrogen tank, 12 Innovation Way: Staff said a building permit for a 9,000-gal vertical liquid nitrogen tank at 12 Innovation Way would be handled administratively, because it is on existing impervious area. Members agreed that staff could handle it.

decision_evidence.quote: There's a motion on the table to grant the waiver. ... And the chair votes in the affirmative. The um waiver has been granted.

decision_titles: Pipe cover waiver at 23 Wilson Road
